headline: GOLD, SILVER TUMBLE as CPI, Oil Spike, and Rebounding Dollar Triple-Pressure Metals
snippet: Gold fell to $4,678/oz on May 12 — down 1.22% — as stronger-than-expected CPI data, surging oil prices tied to the prolonged Strait of Hormuz closure, and a rebounding U.S. dollar converged to weigh on bullion. Silver also retreated from Monday's 6% surge but continues to hold near decade-high levels above $80/oz.

headline: HUDBAY COPPER DEAL SEALED: Arizona Sonoran Shareholders Vote 99% FOR $1.48B Acquisition
snippet: Arizona Sonoran Copper (TSX: ASCU) securityholders voted 99%+ in favour of Hudbay Minerals' $1.48B all-share acquisition at their May 11 special meeting, with the deal set to create the third-largest copper district in North America. Final court approval is scheduled for May 14 — the last remaining condition before closing.

headline: OCEANA HITS 30.64 g/t Au Over 15.5m Underground at Haile Mine, South Carolina
snippet: OceanaGold (TSX: OGC) reported a standout intercept of 15.5m at 30.64 g/t Au from the Horseshoe extensions at its Haile Gold Mine as part of a 34,500m program targeting underground resource conversion. All three mineralized zones lie adjacent to planned development infrastructure, with results continuing to extend the high-grade underground footprint.

headline: THE ANATOMY OF A SILVER BULL RUN: Iran War Reinforces Long-Term Precious Metals Case
snippet: Mike Maharrey at Money Metals argues that while the Iran conflict complicates silver's short-term outlook, it structurally strengthens the long-term case for precious metals by deepening sovereign debt fears, war-related fiscal pressures, and dollar-reserve concerns. Even with Monday's correction, the Silver Institute warns the market remains prone to additional supply squeezes.

headline: ISOENERGY HITS 11.6% U3O8 Over 1.0m at Hurricane South Trend — Athabasca Basin
snippet: IsoEnergy (NYSE American: ISOU) confirmed exceptional uranium grades at the Hurricane South Trend with 11.6% U3O8 over 1.0m and 4.21% over 3.5m in its 2026 winter drill program at Larocque East, Athabasca Basin. Hurricane already hosts 48.6 Mlb U3O8 at 34.5% Indicated, and an 8,000m summer follow-up program is now planned.

headline: 1911 GOLD EXTENDS L10 ZONE to 720m Depth at True North — 11.54 g/t Au Over 3.70m
snippet: 1911 Gold (TSX-V: AUMB) reported 12 drill holes extending the L10 Zone at True North in southeast Manitoba, with a best intercept of 11.54 g/t Au over 3.70m at 720m depth — outside the current mineral resource estimate. Eleven of the 12 holes hit high-grade gold, with drilling potentially linking L10 to the larger 710-711 Zone at depth.

headline: MANHATTAN URANIUM DISCOVERY CORP BORN: Aero Energy Completes Urano + Pegasus Roll-Up
snippet: Aero Energy Limited completed the acquisitions of both Urano Energy and Pegasus Resources via court-approved arrangements and rebranded as Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. (TSX-V: MANU), effective May 7. The deal was approved 99.9% by Urano shareholders and 98.2% by Pegasus shareholders, creating a North American-focused uranium exploration consolidator.

headline: TROILUS MINING Upsizes Debt Mandate to US$1.2 Billion Ahead of Construction Decision
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) upsized its project debt financing mandate to US$1.2 billion, marking a significant step toward a construction decision for one of Canada's largest undeveloped copper-gold assets in Quebec. The company is concurrently running a 40,000m drill campaign to grow resources and test high-grade underground zones ahead of the decision.

headline: GOLD EQUITIES LAG METAL AS CASH FLOWS SURGE — Analyst Sees Prime M&A Window Opening
snippet: Analyst John Feneck argues that gold equities trading well below historical P/NAV multiples — despite Agnico Eagle posting AISC of $1,483/oz against a $4,861 Q1 realized price — creates a textbook acquisition environment. Producers with record cash flow can acquire undervalued juniors for less than it costs to build, a dynamic historically preceding major M&A waves.

headline: GOLD ROYALTY CORP Posts Record Q1: GEOs +162% Year-Over-Year at $9.4M Revenue
snippet: Gold Royalty Corp (NYSE American: GROY) reported record Q1 2026 preliminary revenue of $9.4 million — 1,920 GEOs, up 162% year-over-year — as newly acquired royalties on Pedra Branca and Borborema contributed for the first time. Full-year 2026 guidance of 7,500–9,300 GEOs was reaffirmed with output back-loaded as additional mines ramp up.
